description: Read one of the signed-in user's Clerk support tickets with its conversation, oldest message first. Each message has an author of customer (the user), participant (someone else on the thread, such as a person copied on an email; never the user), or support (Clerk staff). status is open (waiting on Clerk support), awaiting_customer (support replied and is waiting on the user), or closed.
